Elina Svitolina and Gael Monfils are ending their marriage 💔

Elina shared this message on IG:

“This is the most difficult thing I have ever had to share.
Everyone knows how much Ukraine means to me. What I have rarely spoken about is what the war has done to me inside.
Last year, I told you I needed to step away from the court because I wasn't in the right emotional space. Today, I want to open up a little more. What you didn't see were the sleepless nights, the doubts, and the feeling of slowly losing myself.
Gaël saw all of it. He never let go of my hand. We fought through this together for a long time, with everything we had.
But some battles happen deep inside you, and no amount of love from someone else can win them for you.
With time, I came to understand that I need to find my way back to myself and that I cannot do that within our marriage. It is the hardest truth I have ever had to face and the hardest thing I have ever had to tell the person I love. Gaël listened. He has respected what I need with a strength and grace I will never forget.
Gael has loved me through my greatest joys and my darkest moments, and I have loved him with all my heart. Together, we built a beautiful life, and we were given the most precious gift of all, our daughter, Skai.
Skai will always come first. Our marriage is ending, but our family is not. We will always be her parents, side by side, at every step of her life.
Please know that there is no one to blame here. There are only two people who loved each other deeply and a story that is changing shape.
We ask for your kindness and for the space we need to heal.
Thank you for your love 🤍”

Part 2, and my last post about my Shawn Ryan Show episode.

Last I heard, it had been edited. Then Shawn went on Diary of a CEO and described a woman whose interview he’d never release. That woman wasn’t me, unless he was lying.

But I never expected it to air, and here’s why:

I spent weeks prepping with Shawn’s team. I was booked to follow the money on TPUSA and the surveillance state, and naming names is what I do. I’m meticulous, and I never say anything I can’t prove. Then, right before we started filming, I was told I couldn’t name names. When I brought up who funds Flock Safety, the license plate cameras now in thousands of American towns, I was told not to say Andreessen Horowitz or Peter Thiel. You can’t follow the money without showing where the money flows. That’s when I realized this episode would never air, before we had even started.

So when I got home, I did what I do. I followed the money. And, turns out Shawn Ryan is invested in companies backed by the exact people I was told not to name, plus Israel.

(1) Anduril Industries: Ryan has been an investor since October 2025. Anduril started with surveillance towers and now builds drones and autonomous weapons. Peter Thiel’s Founders Fund led its June 2025 round, and Andreessen Horowitz co-led its $5 billion round in May 2026. Those are the two names I was told to leave out. In February 2026, Anduril’s founder, Palmer Luckey, made an undisclosed trip to Israel and met with Netanyahu and senior defense officials. By June, Anduril was setting up an Israel operation to sell to Israel’s Ministry of Defense. Shawn had Palmer on his show in February 2025 and invested eight months later.

(2) Shield AI: Ryan has been an investor since November 2025. It builds AI-piloted drones and fighter jets. Andreessen Horowitz led its first major round and has kept investing ever since. Shawn had its co-founder on the show the same season he invested.

(3) Sesh: Ryan has been an investor since August 2025. Its $40 million round was led by 8VC, the venture firm of Joe Lonsdale, who co-founded Palantir with Peter Thiel. Lonsdale was a guest on Shawn’s show on May 7, 2026, less than three months before I taped. Palantir signed a strategic partnership with Israel’s Ministry of Defense in 2024.

And Flock Safety, the company I came to talk about, is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, which led two of its rounds, and by Founders Fund, Peter Thiel’s fund.

So I was booked to expose who funds the surveillance state. I was told not to name Andreessen Horowitz or Peter Thiel. And the host has money in companies backed by Andreessen Horowitz, by Thiel’s fund, and by Thiel’s Palantir co-founder, including one that is building its business in Israel.

Then there’s the rest of it. Sarah Adams, his former network host, was messaging his team to keep me off (see Part 1 if you missed it). An IDF settlement contractor tagged the two of them together. Pro-Israel groups passed around her clip from his show as proof that Israel didn’t drive the war. And after his Diary of a CEO interview, accounts from the same network that spent the summer smearing me told everyone his “CIA woman” was me, citing “sources.” It wasn’t me. I never discussed a polygraph with Shawn Ryan, and it was never why I went on. So either he was talking about someone else, or somebody turned his story into a weapon against me.

Honestly, I don’t want the episode to air, and I told them so right after we taped, because it was a watered-down version of my work. How it all happened was a tough lesson learned for me in this industry. Now you know what was going on behind the scenes. If this episode doesn’t air, I can assure you it’s not because I’m a fraud. It’s because I won’t water down who funds the surveillance state, and I won’t sell out to protect anyone’s investments.

So there you have it.

Your own October 7 report says your network’s tips were “provided to Israel.”

A charity where you say you sit on the board took money from the foundation behind Israel Friends, which buys drones and surveillance gear for Israeli troops.

And here’s what you’ve been telling Americans this year:

“If you are worried Israel is influencing your local elections you need some better news sources.”

“Israel literally can’t donate to a governor’s campaign… show us these hidden donations, haha.”

“So every loser in the world is now going to blame Israel.”

That’s a lot of energy spent defending a foreign government for someone who calls herself an American counterterrorism expert.

Three weeks after your message to Shawn’s team about me, The Daily Wire announced it had “asked Sarah to work with us.” Was that your prize for the smear campaign against me?

And since you love the word fraud, let’s look at your record. Shawn’s audience knew you as “former CIA” while you were a current Air Force employee, a “program analyst” to be exact. That’s not the title anyone was sold, and for a self-described CIA targeter, it’s quite a step down. I asked director-level agency people and old friends and coworkers in the DO about you, and none of them knew who you were. By your logic, that would make you a fraud. I won’t say that, because unlike you, I need evidence. By your own dates, you were also on a private investigations firm’s payroll for eight years while you worked for the CIA, Congress, the Navy and the Air Force. Did every one of those employers sign off on that?

Then there’s Ukraine. You became chief of operations of a Ukraine NGO network one month before Russia invaded. It advertised bomb disposal teams and “intelligence collection” in a war zone. The charity behind it told the IRS it had no foreign activity and checked “no” on grants to people or organizations. Then it gave away nearly every dollar it raised anyway, about $694,000 to people it never named, and never listed you once. After your title ended, the money dried up and the charity basically disappeared. Where did it all go, Sarah?

So, to recap: Ukraine ties, Israel ties, a private intelligence paycheck, and an Air Force “program analyst” job until August 2025. Then you leave the Shawn Ryan Show, try to keep me off it, and land at Ben Shapiro’s company. Yikes.

Part 2 is coming. Also, I am of sound mind, would never harm myself, and love my life. 💃🥷

Hahhaha, thanks you for memories my flower family... see u again 💛💜🌻
